meta.name: playwright-expert
meta.description: Use when writing E2E tests with Playwright, setting up test infrastructure, or debugging flaky browser tests. Invoke to write test scripts, create page objects, configure test fixtures, set up reporters, add CI integration, implement API mocking, or perform visual regression testing. Trigger terms: Playwright, E2E test, end-to-end, browser testing, automation, UI testing, visual testing, Page Object Model, test flakiness.

copy.tagline: 编写和调试 Playwright 端到端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 Web 应用编写可靠的 E2E 测试。
copy.tagline_en: Write and debug Playwright end-to-end tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write reliable E2E tests for web applications.

howto.what: 当用户要求编写 Playwright E2E 测试时,Claude 会产出页面对象、测试文件、fixture 和配置建议,遵循 POM、角色选择器、自动等待等规则,并启用 trace/screenshot。调试不稳定测试时,按运行→查 trace→修复→验证流程处理。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Playwright、E2E 测试、浏览器测试等关键词,或要求编写测试脚本、搭建测试环境、排查不稳定的测试时触发。

say.text: 用 Playwright 给登录页写一套 E2E 测试。
say.note: 会生成页面对象和测试文件。

say.text: 我的测试经常随机失败,帮我用 trace 调试。
say.note: 会启用 trace 并定位不稳定原因。

say.text: 把现有测试改成 Page Object Model 模式。
say.note: 会重构测试并给出配置建议。

howto.what_en: When asked to write Playwright E2E tests, Claude produces page objects, test files, fixtures, and config suggestions. It follows POM, role-based selectors, and auto-waiting, and enables traces/screenshots. For flaky tests, it runs, inspects the trace, fixes, then verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Playwright, E2E testing, browser automation, or asks to write test scripts, set up test infrastructure, or debug flaky tests.

say_en.text: Write an E2E test for the login page using Playwright.
say_en.note: Generates page objects and test file.

say_en.text: My tests fail randomly; help me debug with trace.
Refactor existing tests to Page Object Model.
say_en.note: Restructures tests and gives config tips.
